checks.criterion: Skill defines isolated paired trials, respondent blindness, independent assessment, and retained evidence
Trial manifest contains hashes, settings, permitted actions, criteria, outcomes and limits
Existing fixture preparer works with the supplied skill root
Source, alias and initialized-workspace distribution checks pass
Changed files are clean and no runtime dependency or model runner was added

runner: Independent design audit plus local protocol and packaging checks
limits: No model was executed; respondent/assessor separation was checked structurally and through fixture preparation.
Synthetic fixture preparation does not establish business behavior or general model reliability.
Native client discovery and external environment execution remain untested.
